svg.title: fixed-swa-layouts
svg.desc: First twelve layers of eight production models, local (L), global (G) or chunked (C): Mistral 7B all local W 4,096; Gemma 2 1:1 W 4,096; Gemma 3 5:1 W 1,024; gpt-oss 1:1 W 128; Llama 4 Scout 3:1 chunk 8,192; OLMo 3 3:1 W 4,096; MiMo-V2-Flash 39 local and 9 global, W 128; DeepSeek-V4-Flash two local layers then CSA/HCA. KV cache at 128K tokens in BF16 versus an all-global stack: Gemma 3 27B 10.4 vs 62.0 GiB; Llama 4 Scout 7.1 vs 24.0 GiB; gpt-oss-120b 4.5 vs 9.0 GiB; MiMo-V2-Flash 2.8 vs 15.0 GiB.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: KV(N) = N · Σglobal cℓ + min(N, W) · Σlocal cℓ

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: cℓ = 2 Hkv dh s per layer
KV cache at N = 128K, BF16, whole model
MiMo: K 192 + V 128 dims; global layers 4 KV heads,
local layers 8; "all global" = 48 × its global layer
